theme_central: A clear declaration of separation from the disbelievers' worship — "to you your religion, and to me mine" — with no compromise or syncretism possible.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Rejection of disbelief
branches.resume: "O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship, and you do not worship what I worship."

children.t: Clear rejection of the disbelievers' worship

branches.title: To you your religion
branches.resume: Insistent repetition of the rejection; closing: "to you your religion, and to me my religion."
